acceptance_and_claim_policy: Report gross and all factor-cost stress scenarios, not only the best result.
Report CAGR, volatility, drawdown, Sharpe, factor-tilt IR, active IR versus v4, and the paired Sharpe interval.
Do not call the factor combination new alpha, factor-neutral alpha, prospective evidence, or investment advice.
Do not hide that the factor sleeve uses academic test-portfolio returns and lacks security-level transaction-cost reconstruction.

locked_combination_design.embargo: 2020 is reported separately and does not fit weights
locked_combination_design.mix_rule: inverse development volatility across v4 net and the fixed factor sleeve
locked_combination_design.secondary_risk_scaled_portfolio: development-only 8% annual volatility target capped at 2.0x leverage
locked_combination_design.v4_input: $100 million AUM / 150-bp annual borrow net return series

locked_cost_reporting.limitation: flat factor haircuts are stress scenarios, not security-level implementation estimates; academic Fama-French returns are not directly investable
locked_cost_reporting.v4_costs: already include lagged spread, nonlinear impact, and 150-bp annual borrow assumptions

locked_factor_design.assessment_dates: v4 formation months 2021-01-01 through 2024-11-30 aligned to factor-return months 2021-02 through 2024-12
locked_factor_design.selection_rule: all six factors remain eligible; weak development factors receive smaller rather than outcome-selected zero weights
locked_factor_design.weight_rule: 50% equal weight plus 50% normalized positive development Sharpe; cap each factor at 30% and redistribute any excess pro rata

locked_metrics.active_information_ratio_vs_v4: combined unlevered return minus v4 net return, reported even if negative
locked_metrics.factor_tilt_information_ratio: tilted combination minus otherwise identical equal-factor combination, annualized mean divided by annualized tracking error
locked_metrics.ic_policy: the combined portfolio has no cross-sectional IC; version-4 score IC remains the applicable stock-selection diagnostic
locked_metrics.paired_interval: 5000-repetition circular 12-month moving-block interval for combined-minus-v4 Sharpe
locked_metrics.sharpe: annualized mean monthly return divided by annualized monthly volatility

motivation: Version 4 produced positive net returns and strong rank IC but essentially zero FF5-plus-momentum residual alpha.
The allocation layer therefore leans into established premiums deliberately instead of presenting explained returns as novel alpha.
All factor and v4 assessment returns through 2024 had already been inspected; no pristine validation claim is possible.
